en_quote: OneFrance, a fully digital challenger bank operating in France plans to expand into the rest of Europe. The bank hires Marie as a consultant to review the effectiveness and efficiency of its onboarding technology. OneFrance prides itself on using advanced technology throughout its AFC program, including the onboarding process.
knowledge_zh: 案例：法国数字银行OneFrance计划扩张，聘请顾问审查其金融犯罪防控准入技术

en_quote: Marie is an expert in digital banking, regulatory technology, and compliance. She assesses the bank’s electronic KYC processes and notices various deficiencies.
knowledge_zh: Marie评估银行的电子了解你的客户流程并发现缺陷

en_quote: As part of OneFrance’s onboarding process, customers must take a selfie and submit it on the app to be verified against documents they have.
knowledge_zh: 客户需在应用程序上提交自拍照以验证身份

en_quote: During the process, the geolocation of the customers is recorded to ensure they are within the EU when opening an account.
knowledge_zh: 开户时记录客户地理位置以确保其在欧盟境内

en_quote: The bank also screens all the new customers’ names against the required sanctions lists during onboarding.
knowledge_zh: 银行在开户时对所有新客户姓名进行制裁名单筛查

en_quote: Marie notes that currently the system only verifies 80% of customers through facial recognition technology.
knowledge_zh: 当前系统仅通过面部识别技术验证80%的客户

en_quote: This is due to the inadequacy of the system the bank purchased from a vendor.
knowledge_zh: 低验证率源于银行从供应商处购买的系统不完善

en_quote: The system does not incorporate strong liveness checks and is not properly integrated with the document processing system that extracts ID pictures from identity books and passports.
knowledge_zh: 系统缺乏活体检测且未与证件处理系统集成

en_quote: The system cannot reliably match selfies customers take during the onboarding process to ID pictures.
knowledge_zh: 系统无法可靠地将客户自拍照与证件照片匹配

en_quote: This leads to a team of analysts manually checking unverified customers, increasing onboarding time.
knowledge_zh: 未验证客户需分析师手动检查，增加开户时间

en_quote: Marie also identifies that during the screening process, one specific common French name keeps matching against the European sanctions list, generating false positives that analysts must address.
knowledge_zh: 常见法国名字与欧盟制裁名单匹配产生误报

en_quote: After further investigation, she notes that the system uses partial match logic to identify possible hits and does not allow deviations in names.
knowledge_zh: 系统使用部分匹配逻辑且不允许姓名偏差

en_quote: The system keeps matching “Henri” against “Henrik,” which is indicated on the list.
knowledge_zh: 误报示例：'Henri'与名单上的'Henrik'匹配

en_quote: Similarly, the system seems to be missing matches when the name is slightly different from its appearance on watch lists.
knowledge_zh: 系统在姓名与观察名单略有差异时遗漏匹配
